---
title: "Assessment preparation checklist"
format: html
---

This checklist was moved from the SSC response page. It records tasks that were
listed for the planned 2025 assessment update. A lapse in funding prevented the
November and December 2025 SAFE package, so the list should be reviewed and
updated before it is used for 2026 assessment planning.

# Data updates

- [ ] Insert final 2024 commercial catches (fleet/gear, retained/discards)
- [ ] Verify Russian catch updates
- [ ] Add 2025 BTS biomass and age comps
- [ ] Add 2024 ATS age comps (no new biomass estimate in 2025)
- [ ] Update 2025 AVO index
- [ ] Insert 2024-2025 fishery age/length comps
- [ ] Re-weight composition data (effective sample sizes)
- [ ] Update environmental/ancillary indices (copepod, sea ice, etc.)
- [ ] Check FT-NIR age validation / genetics updates

# Model inputs and structure

- [ ] Update input data files to 2025 terminal year
- [ ] Handle missing ATS biomass index (skip-year) correctly
- [ ] Re-examine composition weighting method
- [ ] Review variance inflation factors for surveys
- [ ] Check selectivity blocks and time-varying assumptions

# Model runs and diagnostics

- [ ] Extend base model to 2025
- [ ] Confirm convergence and parameter plausibility
- [ ] Run sensitivities (recruitment assumptions, survey weighting, Russian
  catch)
- [ ] Update retrospective analysis (peels including 2025)
- [ ] Update likelihood profiles (steepness, M, selectivity)
- [ ] Run MCMC/posterior sampling; check diagnostics (R-hat, ESS)

# Reference points and projections

- [ ] Recalculate SSB, B40%, F40% (or proxy values)
- [ ] Update FABC and FOFL for 2026
- [ ] Run 2026-2036 projections with recruitment assumptions
- [ ] Update alternative harvest scenarios

# Document and presentation updates

- [ ] Update SAFE text, tables, and executive summary
- [ ] Replace 2024 values with 2025 throughout
- [ ] Revise all figures (surveys, selectivity, fits, Kobe plots)
- [ ] Ensure consistency (no outdated numbers left in text)
- [ ] Check table/figure numbering
- [ ] Address 2025 PT/SSC requests

*Notes: Acoustic-trawl biomass index is static at 2024; only ATS ages are
updated. AVO index extends to 2025. Main survey input is 2025 BTS.*
